morning5_start.name: Me
morning5_start.text: *Day five. The last day. The uniform feels comfortable now. Five days ago it was stiff, but now it fits. — Have I gotten used to this school, or to these people?*

morning5_start_2.name: Me
morning5_start_2.text: *There's a school event today. The final one. The moment I step into the classroom — signals come from three directions.*

morning5_seo_note_1.name: Me
morning5_seo_note_1.text: *There's a note on my desk. Seoyeon's handwriting. — 'Make some time this afternoon. I'll leave the rooftop unlocked. — Seoyeon'*

morning5_yuna_story_1.name: Me
morning5_yuna_story_1.text: *Passing by the literature club's display corner in the hallway — a short story is pinned to the bulletin board. Title: 'To the Person I Met in the Library.' It's Yuna's. — A story only the protagonist would recognize.*

morning5_dain_1.name: 다인(Dain)
morning5_dain_1.text: "Hey! I signed you up as my partner for today's sports event!"

morning5_dain_2.name: 다인(Dain)
morning5_dain_2.text: "If you try to run, I'll seriously be mad?"

morning5_end.name: Me
morning5_end.text: *It's a question, but it's a threat. — Classic Dain.*
